questions.question:
**Select the correct Indirect form of the given sentence.**

“Let’s sit out in the sun,” Anya said.

options.text: Anya suggested that we sit out in the sun.
Anya had suggested that we sit out in the sun.
Anya is suggesting that we sit out in the sun.
Anya was suggesting that we sit out in the sun.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is - **Anya suggested that we sit out in the sun.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the steps to change the sentence from direct to indirect speech:
 
• When the direct speech is in an imperative form, we follow the steps given below:
 
 
• Change the sentence in direct speech from imperative to assertive.
 
• The tense of reported speech is changed only when the reporting verb is in the past tense. 
 
• The reporting verb said is converted into suggested.
 
• 'That' is used in place of comma and inverted commas followed by the pronoun '**we**' which replaces **Let's**.
 
 
 
• At last, line up the remaining part.

 

Following these steps, we finally get - *Anya suggested that we sit out in the sun.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The vet told me to put eye drops and ointment in my pet’s eyes.

options.text: I was being told by the vet to put eye drops and ointment in my pet’s eyes.
I was told by the vet to put eye drops and ointment in my pet’s eyes.
I had been told by the vet to put eye drops and ointment in my pet’s eyes.
I am being told by the vet to put eye drops and ointment in my pet’s eyes.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **I was told by the vet to put eye drops and ointment in my pet’s eyes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in an active voice form, hence we need to convert it into a passive voice form.
 
• Find the subject (The vet) and object (me) of the sentence and exchange their places. 
 
• The given sentence is in the simple past tense. The passive verb form for simple past is: 
 
 
• was/were + past participle form of the verb.
 
• So, '**told**' changes to 'was told'.
 
 
 
• At last line up the remaining part.

 

Following these steps, we finally get- *I was told by the vet to put eye drops and ointment in my pet’s eyes.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** *​​​​

 
• Certain verbs are followed by certain prepositions. Some of them are given below:

 
 
• vexed at, surprise/astonished/amazed at, known to, tired of, engulfed in, etc.
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *His weird behaviour surprised me. (active)*
 
• *I was surprised at his weird behavior. (passive)*

questions.question:
**In the sentence identify the segment which contains the grammatical error.**

Firecrackers have seized by the government went off while being defused on the banks of the river Ganga, in a town in West Bengal.

options.text: on the banks of the river Ganga
in a town in West Bengal

questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The present perfect tense is a verb tense that shows an action or state that either occurred at an indefinite time in the past or began in the past and continued to the present time.
 
• The structure is given below:
 
 
• Subject + has/have + V3 + object. (active voice)
 
• Object + has/have + been + V3 + subject. (passive voice)
 
 
 
• ​Example:
 
 
• *​He has played some matches for the Indian Cricket team. (active voice)*
 
• *Some matches have been played by him for the Indian Cricket team. (passive voice)*
 
 
 
• In the given blank, we need to follow the structure in the passive voice form as reflected by the usage of the preposition 'by'.
 
• Hence according to the rule given above, 'have been seized' is the most appropriate choice.

 

Correct Sentence__: *Firecrackers **have been seized** by the government went off while being defused on the banks of the river Ganga, in a town in West Bengal.*
